recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR-core source change is needed for this issue; unrelated editorial cleanup around stale reasonCode wording should be handled under a separate tracker or the tracker that owns the R5 reason merge.
issue_request: FHIR-10352 was Published/Persuasive with Modification for Patient Care and requested Communication.reasonReference and CommunicationRequest.reasonReference be changed to Reference(Any) with 0..* cardinality.
initial_application: The issue was applied by fd021062fc5a010ce4ff3cab2d6b8127527811f2, which changed the then-authoritative Communication and CommunicationRequest spreadsheet rows from Reference(Condition|Observation|DiagnosticReport|DocumentReference) to Reference(Any) and tagged them with GF#10352.
additional_context: The current build no longer has separate reasonCode/reasonReference elements; source/fhir.ini records the R5 merge into reason and maps reasonReference to reason.reference. FHIR-25795 later confirmed in Patient Care that the current build's Communication.reason as CodeableReference(Any) was intentional and traced that change to FHIR-10352. Zulip and Confluence searches found no conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current active StructureDefinitions define Communication.reason and CommunicationRequest.reason as 0..* CodeableReference with targetProfile Resource, which is the current-source representation of the requested Reference(Any) behavior after the R5 reason merge.
